description: This file defines a PHP trait 'NormalizerTrait' used for normalizing model objects and arrays within the OrangeHRM system, including methods for validation and instantiation of models.

methods.name: getModelClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the model being normalized.

methods.name: setModelClass
methods.description: Sets the class name of the model to be normalized.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves the data to be normalized.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets the data to be normalized.

methods.name: normalizeObject
methods.description: Normalizes a single object by converting it to an array.

methods.name: normalizeObjectsArray
methods.description: Normalizes an array of objects by converting each to an array.

methods.name: checkForValidModelClass
methods.description: Validates that the model class implements the Normalizable interface.

methods.name: getInitializedModelInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of the model class, passing data if required.
